detail.longDescription: I am trying to use pydicom to store a float as a field DS. It appears that it should be working automagically since issue 1264 has been closed: https://github.com/pydicom/pydicom/issues/1264 However I failed to understand the document on how to use those new magic flags Code is: from pydicom.dataset import Dataset, FileDataset, FileMetaDataset from pydicom import config config.auto_format = True import pydicom pydicom.config.settings.auto_format = True def main(): ds = Dataset() comp = 11.79395969374598 ds.LossyImageCompressionRatio = comp file_ds = FileDataset("test.dcm", ds) file_ds.is_little_endian = True file_ds.is_implicit_VR = False file_ds.save_as("test.dcm") if __name__ == "__main__": main() Which leads to: $ dcmdump test.dcm | tail -1 (0028,2112) DS [11.79395969374598] # 18, 1 LossyImageCompressionRatio I am using pydicom 3.0.2
